title: Prefill: sparse MLA + prologue
shape: NVFP4 1-node DEP16 slice (L24 view: 18 KDA + 6 DSA + 23 MoE layers), F16K at L78K, ms per forward
basis: MEASURED in-step NVFP4 baseline (INFRA 17:48, wzhao/k31ws-int b31121cf56, runs/INFRA/step_p/int-b31121c-nv-f16f8-prof; measured/20261118-1805-nvfp4-prefill.json); achievable = nvfp4_modelopt model at the same slice
gap_analysis: Per F16K layer (1 GPU, run1): trtllm-gen sparse MLA 2129.5 us (3.29 PF on the 96 real heads; model 643), quant 204.1 + head pad 173.4 + KV insert 42.0 (model prologue 10.9), gate_mul 128.8 (model 7.7). Hardware probes (run2/run3): tcgen05 FP8 2x-K MMA reaches the full rate only with A in TMEM; every SMEM operand byte costs 1/128 clk (128 B/clk/SM operand fetch, measured flat across N and majorness), so both-operands-in-SMEM forms (keys-on-M / transposed) cap at 43% (N=96). TMA writes into SMEM at about 55 B/clk do not slow a full-rate TS MMA (no read/write contention measured). TMA tile::gather4 is issue-bound at about 56 clk per instruction per issuing warp: 1/2/4 warps reach 4.1/7.0/10.9 TB/s of 576 B row gathers; plain LDG gathers reach 18.2 TB/s (1064 us per F16K layer). The per-token gather (2048 rows x 576 B = 19.3 GB per F16K layer, L2->SM) is not in the model (kv_B counts 135 MB of unique KV), and neither is the SMEM operand traffic (36.5 GB per layer at 128 B/clk/SM = 565 us). The stock kernel's 2-CTA HVPerCta256 layout most likely re-gathers V (about 1.9x the minimum gather bytes; inferred from its name and FlashMLA's documented equivalent, ncu is not in the image), which at the measured gather rates explains its 2.1 ms. Measured gather floor (run4): ~18 TB/s for random 576 B rows -> sparse_mla cannot go below ~1.07 ms/layer (25.7 ms/step at F16K) with one gather per token-row; the model (643 us/layer) misses this term. Proposed corrected achievable for the family: 24 x (1.07 + 0.019) = ~26 ms/step (model fix pending owner review).
inefficiencies: Stock trtllm-gen kernel: 2-CTA M128, heads padded 96->128, V half likely re-gathered per CTA -> ~2x the minimum L2->SM gather bytes; its 2.08 ms/layer matches 2x the measured ~1.07 ms gather floor (inference, no ncu in the image)

Perf model omits the per-token KV row gather: F16K layer gathers 19.3 GB at a measured ~18 TB/s floor (LDG and TMA gather4 alike; die-local KV placement makes no difference) -> ~1.07 ms/layer, 1.67x the model sparse_mla achievable
Query quant + head pad: two passes (378 us/layer); the one-kernel Triton concat+quant+pad is slower at 16K rows (422 us); a native-96-head attention kernel removes the pad pass (174 us/layer)
gate_mul separate pass over [T, 12288] BF16 (129 us/layer; target: w_uv batched GEMM epilogue)

New keys-on-M kernel: correct but ~8.8K clk per 128-key tile (2.2x slower than stock); per-tile serial chain not yet traced (HYPOTHESIS: one tile of gathers in flight with 2 KV stages held QK->softmax->PV)
rubin_features: tcgen05 FP8 kind::f8f6f4 with the Rubin 2x-K instruction descriptor
TMEM A operands (Q, P) to stay under the SMEM operand-fetch limit
576-column exclusive TMEM allocation (2-CTA M128 folded O 256 + S + full Q in TMEM)
cta_group::2 M128 MMA pairs with TMA tile::gather4 multicast to the pair (gather each row once)
many-warp TMA gather issue (gather4 is issue-bound per warp)
oversized (>227 KiB) shared memory carveout for deeper KV rings
PDL between prologue, attention and w_uv
plan: 1. DONE stock chain, operand-fetch, gather floors (LDG, gather4 1-16 warps, multicast pairs, aligned pitch)
2. DONE model fix evidence: delivered-bytes cap ~18 TB/s -> F16K floor 1.07 ms/layer for one gather per token-row; corrected achievable for the slice = 6 x (1.07 + 0.019) = 6.53 ms (target 7.2)
3. Keys-on-M kernel to the floor: phase trace (run11) -> 3-stage ring + many TMA gather warps + pipelined MMA order + cheap softmax; target ~1.12-1.2 ms/layer
4. Dispatch on (DISPATCH=True when it beats trtllm-gen at F8K/F16K): removes the head-pad pass (174 us/layer)
5. Prologue: Q FP8 quant fused (into the attention kernel's Q load or the w_uk epilogue, stock rounding)
7. tests vs stock, microbench F8K/F16K, step_p A/B on an int-based overlay, landed-ready

run10: gather floor with multicast CTA pairs (cluster 2, each CTA gathers half the quads, multicast to both) and a 128 B aligned row pitch
work.result: single-CTA 16 warps 17.5 TB/s (1104 us at F16K); multicast pairs deliver 18.7 TB/s total = 9.3 TB/s unique (2071 us); pitch 640 no change. The cap is on bytes delivered into SMs: a KV row placed in two SMs costs twice. Rules out every 2-CTA V-split layout (incl. stock's); the SOL form is one SM per token with all 96 heads and all 512 V dims (keys-on-M, S^T 96 + O^T 384 TMEM cols).
